value.signature: fn encode_header (parts : & HeaderParts) -> Result < VerifiedHeader , EncodingError >

review.body: { let encoded = header_value (parts) ? . to_canonical_bytes () ; if encoded . len () > HEADER_LIMIT { return Err (EncodingError :: Bound) ; } Ok (VerifiedHeader { parts : parts . clone () , bytes : encoded , }) }
review.item_premise: Public typed header fields produce canonical major-three bytes; encoding neither signs nor verifies them.
